$schema_notes: Budgets for scripts/bench-check.mjs. duration_ms_median is a wall-clock ceiling (Linux CI). payload_chars_median is a per-scenario payload weight ceiling (~4 chars = 1 token). tolerance is a per-scenario override; default_tolerance is applied when a scenario does not set one. Calibrate on the master baseline: an intentional trade-off updates the numbers in the same PR, so the diff explains the move.
$calibration_notes: Initial values seeded from a first Windows dev run (Node 24, noisy machine). CI runs Linux; first CI pass on master seeds the durable baseline.
